page: Amazon Web Services m8ib.24xlarge is a general-purpose instance built on the Nitro hypervisor and driven by Intel x86_64 processors. It is configured with 96 vCPUs sourced from 48 dedicated physical cores with multithreading support, operating at a base frequency of 3.9 GHz. System memory totals 384.0 GB, establishing a uniform 1:4 core-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware accelerators such as GPUs are absent from this configuration.

The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps, enabling efficient data transfer across large distributed environments. Local disk storage is not bundled with the server, meaning storage requirements rely entirely on external network-attached block devices. The reliance on remote storage is offset by high network throughput, which prevents networking bottlenecks during large-scale disk and node-to-node communication.

With its balanced compute and memory distribution, m8ib.24xlarge functions effectively across varied enterprise environments. Typical operational profiles include large web serving fleets, distributed caching nodes, batch data processing, continuous integration systems, and containerized application clusters.
